mechanism.claim: During elevated realized variation, a canonical twenty-period Detrended Price Oscillator crossing zero on completed four-hour BTC auctions identifies a change in the isolated intermediate price cycle; follow the new cycle sign for twenty-four hours.
mechanism.side: long when DPO crosses strictly above zero; short when DPO crosses strictly below zero
mechanism.why_distinct: DPO compares the close eleven completed bars ago with the current twenty-bar simple mean, deliberately removing current trend alignment. It is not a current-price moving-average crossover, return oscillator, range path, recursive filter, volume, flow, OI, funding, fitted outcome, reused event set, or promoted control.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: completed trailing twenty-four-hour realized variation must rank in its causal upper 35%
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: sparse displaced-cycle zero crossings are absent from Gross9 primitives

features.source_bar: exact aggregation of 240 coherent BTCUSDT one-minute rows [T-4h,T)
features.sma: simple mean of the latest twenty uninterrupted completed bar closes including current
features.displaced_close: completed close exactly eleven bars before current
features.event: strict finite zero crossing from immediately prior finite DPO
features.variation: sqrt(sum squared completed one-minute open-to-close log returns over [T-24h,T)), finite strict positive
features.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 180 earlier valid decisions, minimum 120, current excluded; rank>=0.65

clock.feature_available: four-hour boundary after completed source bar
clock.entry: exact BTCUSDT open five elapsed minutes later
clock.reservation: global half-open first-eligible reservation; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not a signal input; exact settlements only after novelty passes

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged candidate passes train, test, eval, final

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: canonical DPO(20) displaced-cycle zero crossing under the requested high-variation regime

stopping_rule: Terminal first failure; no period, displacement, formula, crossing, variation, side, hold, clock, subset, control, or other repair.

external_basis.origin: William Blau, canonical Detrended Price Oscillator convention
external_basis.fixed_definition: period 20; displacement floor(20/2)+1=11; DPO=close eleven completed bars ago minus current 20-period simple average; zero line
external_basis.selection_use: published input, default period, displacement, formula, and zero reference only; no incidence or outcomes
